name: VPN
author: juansebas7ian
description: Surfshark and Proton VPN (Free) in one panel: connect a server with one click (WireGuard profiles in NetworkManager, no root), public IP and country, DNS and IPv6 leak check, import configs from ~/Downloads, open the official apps.

barWidget.description: Left = panel · right = connect the last server / disconnect. Filled shield = connected; red = IPv6 leaking around the tunnel.
